verdict.rationale: Elicit clearly ships AI-generated insight features from user data — chat with papers (compare/summarize/cluster), Research Agent producing reports/columns/figures, and Systematic Review reports (elicit-docs-40, elicit-docs-12, elicit-docs-22) — but independent hands-on reports document concrete failures: hallucinated facts, incorrect summaries misrepresenting confirmed hypotheses, and quotes contradicting the AI's own claims (elicit-comm-3, elicit-comm-4, elicit-comm-7), and Elicit's own docs admit ~90% accuracy requiring close verification (elicit-comm-2). Missing for 10: independent corroboration that generated insights are reliably accurate, resolution of documented hallucination reports.
